name: Regret
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of regret but calls believers to trust in God's sovereign timing and redemptive power. Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is a season for every purpose, cautioning against longing for former days as a wise perspective. Isaiah encourages us to leave behind past failures and embrace God's promise of redemption and belonging. Furthermore, Joel assures restoration for lost years, while Mark emphasizes faith-filled prayer as a means to receive God's blessings, inviting believers to move forward in hope rather than dwelling on regret.
